Dear Alexander,
I hope this email finds you well.
I shared the logs with my team to also confirm the information I shared
Indeed the EVSE_MaxPwr[kw] is the maximun power, but it was never under the voltage the car was asking for.
During the session the car was asking 5 we was delivering 5 and the maximum was 5.
If the card was asking for more and the charger was not able to delivery, we could see the EV_TarCur above the amperes on the EVSE

I hope this email finds you well.
I apologise regarding the information I shared.
EVSE_MaxPwr is indeed the maximum power we have related with the configuration but it doesn't have relation with this session.
The power delivery limited is not in the logs for the session ID=112 but with the ELMS logs.
On the following screenshot, I confirmed with our experts and we suggest to check the ELMS because it is limiting the power to delivery.
